decision.observation: Hornet stands behind the tapered dark pillars at the right edge of the lit pillar chamber, needle visible; the mossy rubble bank with pale shell-stones lies to the left, and the shell-mosaic wall with the pink coral cluster rises at the upper right. Beyond the pillars is solid darkness.
decision.hypothesis: This chamber is a dead end at all heights tested. The genuinely unclimbed feature elsewhere is the west green grotto's stacked round mossy platforms, so retracing left through the rubble bank toward the other chambers is the plan.
decision.memory: Pillar/coral chamber dead-end confirmed across many probes. Plan: west across the lit pocket → dark corridor → hub → west grotto → climb the stacked round platforms.
